verses.text: Then the LORD said to me, "Even if Moses and Samuel stood before me pleading for these people, I would not change my mind toward them. Send them away from me! Let them go!

And if they ask you, 'Where should we go?' tell them, 'This is what the LORD says: Those meant for death, to death. Those meant for the sword, to the sword. Those meant for hunger, to hunger. Those meant for captivity, to captivity.'
I will send four kinds of destroyers against them," says the LORD. "The sword to kill, the dogs to drag away, and the birds of the sky and the wild animals to eat and destroy.
I will make them something that horrifies all the kingdoms of the earth, because of what Manasseh son of Hezekiah, king of Judah, did in Jerusalem.
Who will have pity on you, Jerusalem? Who will mourn for you? Who will stop to ask how you are doing?
You have rejected me," says the LORD. "You keep turning your back on me. So I will reach out my hand and destroy you. I am tired of holding back.
I will separate them like chaff with a winnowing fork at the gates of the land. I will take away their children and destroy my people, for they have not changed their ways.
I will make their widows more numerous than the sand of the sea. At noon I will bring a destroyer against the mothers of young men. I will suddenly bring on them pain and terror.

The mother of seven will grow weak and breathe her last. Her sun will set while it is still day. She will be shamed and disgraced. I will hand over those who survive to the sword in front of their enemies," says the LORD.
How terrible for me, my mother, that you gave birth to me! Everyone in the land argues and fights with me. I have never lent money or borrowed it, yet everyone curses me.
The LORD said, "Surely I will rescue you for a good purpose. Surely I will make your enemies beg you for help in times of disaster and trouble.
Can anyone break iron, the iron from the north, or bronze?
I will give away your riches and your treasures as plunder, free of charge, because of all your sins throughout your land.
I will make you serve your enemies in a land you do not know, for my anger has started a fire that will burn against you."
LORD, you understand. Remember me and take care of me. Pay back those who chase after me. You are patient, so do not let me be taken away. Think of how I suffer insults for your sake.
When your words came, I ate them up. They became my joy and the delight of my heart, for I am called by your name, LORD God of Armies.
I never sat with the crowds who laugh and party. I sat alone because your hand was on me, and you filled me with anger at their sin.
Why does my pain never end? Why is my wound so serious that it cannot be healed? Will you be to me like a stream that runs dry, like a spring that fails?

So this is what the LORD says: "If you come back to me, I will take you back, and you will serve me again. If you speak words that are worthy and not worthless, you will be my spokesman. Let these people turn to you, but you must not turn to them.
I will make you a strong bronze wall against these people. They will fight against you, but they will not defeat you, for I am with you to save you and rescue you," says the LORD.
"I will rescue you from the hands of the wicked and save you from the grip of the cruel."
